nodes.description: Mapping of address to token balance; read and written in transfer/transferFrom/balanceOf/constructor without safe math.
Nested mapping address=>address=>uint256 of allowances; written in approve/approveAndCall and decremented in transferFrom.
Public total token supply set once in the ERC20Token constructor.
Public token name string, set in the constructor.
Public decimals value, set in the constructor.
Public token symbol string, set in the constructor.
Public version string initialized to 'H1.0'.
Transfers _value from msg.sender to _to; performs unchecked balance additions/subtractions.
Transfers _value from _from to _to using allowance of msg.sender; unchecked arithmetic on balances and allowed.
Constant function returning balances[_owner].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval.
Constant function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Payable fallback function of ERC20Token that throws on any plain ether transfer.
Constructor granting the deployer 10000000000000000 tokens and setting totalSupply/name/decimals/symbol.
Approves _spender then makes an unchecked low-level external call to receiveApproval on that address.
Caller-controlled address used as the source of transfers, the allowance owner and the initial token holder.
Unchecked external call _spender.call(receiveApproval...) executed after the allowance state write, enabling state manipulation by the callee.
Recipient address parameter _to of transfer.
Amount parameter _value used in transfer/transferFrom/approve/approveAndCall arithmetic.
Source address parameter _from of transferFrom.
Address parameter _owner of balanceOf/allowance.
Address parameter _spender of approve/approveAndCall/allowance.
Arbitrary bytes parameter _extraData forwarded in the external receiveApproval call.

edges.reason: msg.sender supplies the balance used as the transfer source.
msg.sender indexes the allowance consumed by transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping written by approve.
msg.sender receives the entire initial token supply in the constructor.
msg.sender is the allowance owner and the caller forwarded to the external contract.

_value is added to balances[_to] and subtracted from balances[msg.sender] without overflow checks.

_owner is the first key of the allowance lookup.

_value is passed as an argument into the external call payload.

transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.

Constructor writes the deployer balance in the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the nested allowance entry of msg.sender.
approve writes the allowed nested mapping.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.

version state variable is available to the contract.
approveAndCall transfers control to the low-level external call after updating the allowance state.
The external callee can re-enter approveAndCall or other state-mutating functions before the call returns.

normalization_plan.reason: _to has no role outside transfer and is folded into the receiving function node.
_value is the amount handled by transfer's unchecked balance arithmetic.
_from is only used to index the debited balance inside transferFrom.
_owner is only an index used by the read-only balanceOf lookup.
_spender is the allowance key written by approve.
_extraData is only meaningful as the payload of the external call made by approveAndCall.
